'''Republic At War''' is the first of two releases of [[Virtual Block 9]], a legacy virtual expansion. Its text is official as of 10 January 2014.<ref name="pdf" /> The release has 77 card slips (34 Dark Side, 43 Light Side); each of its two objectives takes two slips.<ref name="pdf" />

== Discrepancies ==
* The cover counts 77 cards (34 Dark Side, 43 Light Side).<ref name="pdf" /> These are slips: the card list has 75 cards (33 Dark Side, 42 Light Side), because each of the two objectives takes two slips.
